Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! Sri Lanka have sealed the series with a game to go. Bangladesh though still have pride to play for. The third and the final ODI of the series is going to be played on the 31st of July at 2.30 pm local (0900 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Sri Lanka skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne, says they did really well and they are happy they won a series after a long time. States he wanted to bat first but he can't control the toss and he needed to do well in the game. Mentions the pacers did well and the spinners too were very good. Further adds Akila Dananjaya did really well on his comeback. Ends by saying the lines and lengths Akila bowled were very good and he built the pressure and that is exactly what they wanted.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal says they wanted to bat and added a spinner as they knew this wicket was going to spin. Admits that 270 would have been a good score on this wicket as it was not a 300 pitch. Further admits that it has been a disappointing series for them. Feels they have had their moments and adds that the 15 members that are here, they have full confidence in them and he does not want to talk about players that are not here. Tamim feels that they have not been able to capitalize when they were on top of the game and that has been the difference.

MAN OF THE MATCH, AVISHKA FERNANDO. On being asked about the change in batting position, Fernando says that he is happy to bat wherever the team requires him to. Admits that he is disappointed to miss out on a hundred but hopes to get it in the final ODI. On the pitch, Avishka tells that it got slower as the game progressed.

Mathews is now down for an interview. On being asked how it feels after winning a home series after so long, Mathews admits that they have not played good cricket for the last couple of years and further admits that they have disappointed the fans. Thanks them for still coming out in numbers and supporting them. On being asked what was the talk between him and Mendis out in the middle, Angelo tells that they had lost three wickets and the plan was to bat till the end as they knew they had a lot of time.

Earlier in the day, it was the Lankan bowlers who set up the victory. They bowled with a lot of discipline. Akila Dananjaya was the pick as he finished with a two-fer. For Bangladesh, it was Rahim's effort which single-handedly took them to 238 but it proved to be an easy chase for Lanka.

Bangladesh needed early wickets if they were to defend this total but they did not get any. Their bowlers were guilty of bowling either too short or too full which did not help them get assistance from the surface. Mehedi and Mustafizur Rahman did pick 1 and 2 wickets respectively, but it was after the damage was done. Overall, the Bangladesh players will not be happy with their bowling performance not only in this game but in the last one too.

The new ball was going to be crucial as the wicket was said to get slower as the game progressed and the Lankan openers came out all guns blazing. Especially Fernando, who hit the bowlers at will. The two added 71-runs for the opening stand and provided the ideal start. Perera then came in and kept the good work going with Fernando. The latter fell 18 short of a ton but he surely did his job. Perera too soon followed but Mathews and Mendis, with a 96-run stand, took Lanka over the line. Angelo Mathews got to yet another ODI fifty.

That was too easy for Sri Lanka! Two games and both have been won by them quite convincingly. In the first one they batted first and defended with relative ease and in the second one, they chased a total which many believed was under par.

FOUR! Mathews finishes it off in style! He also brings up his half ton. Angelo gets a loopy ball on middle which he lofts straight down the ground and bags a boundary! SRI LANKA WIN THE GAME BY 7 WICKETS AND SEAL THE SERIES!
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
FOUR! SCORES LEVEL! A half-tracker on middle, Mathews goes back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out to the bowler.
Another dot as Mendis blocks the last ball out.
On off, this is blocked.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
This is floated on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, Mathews looks to cut but mistimes it to point.
FOUR! Just over! It has not been Bangladesh's day today. A full toss on middle, Mathews does not get it off the middle but clears the leaping mid off fielder for a boundary. 7 runs needed now.
Edged but short! Floats it up on middle, Mathews looks to whip it against the turn. It goes off the outside edge but short of short third man.
Very full on middle, this is jammed out to mid on.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, Mendis works it to mid-wicket.
Sabbir Rahman is back!
Outside off, this is guided through point for one. 2 hits away now are Sri Lanka.
Flatter and on off, Mendis goes back and looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller on off, Mendis strokes it to mid on.
Brings out the paddle sweep towards fine leg for one.

This is flatter and outside off, it turns back in. Mathews goes back and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Tamim thinks of a review but then bails out. Too high.
Flatter on off, the batter defends it out.
A full toss on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
This time Mehedi bowls it flatter and Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top edge but a boundary! Mathews now plays the sweep shot. He gets a top edge but it goes fine on the leg side and a boundary results.
Make that 19 as Mendis sweeps it through square leg.
Flatter and on off, this is worked around the corner for one. 20 needed now.
Another run as this is eased down to long on for one.
Powerplay 3 signalled by the umpire. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this innings.
One more single as Mendis works it through mid-wicket. Sri Lanka are happy to do it in singles here.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
This is worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
This is fired on middle, Mendis looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
A dot to end as the last ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
Good bowling! The arm ball on off, Mathews plays for the turn but there ain't any. He gets beaten.
On off again, Mathews pushes it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Shorter and on off, there is extra bounce. Mendis looks to pull but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, it turns back in. Mendis works it to short fine leg.
FOUR! Beautifully driven. Fuller on off, Mathews gets on his front foot and drives it beautifully through covers. He holds onto the pose for a second for the cameras.
Comes over the wicket and bowls it very full on middle and leg, Mathews looks to flick but ends up getting a leading edge towards point.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Mathews pulls it over mid-wicket. He does not time it well enough but luckily the ball falls well short of the man at deep mid-wicket.
Full on the pads, Mathews flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Corrects his line and bowls it on middle, Angelo tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Bad ball from Mustafizur. He bowls it down the leg side, Mathews just helps it on its way fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
Loopy ball on off, Mathews defends it off the front foot with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.
Floated on middle, Angelo taps it back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery on middle stump, Mendis pushes it to mid on. A single taken.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Mendis cuts to third man. No run.
Another short delivery, Mathews plays it on the leg side towards square leg  for a single.
Shortish in length spinning a little, Mathews flicks it to fine leg. No run.
Floated around off, KM cuts it to the man at point.

FOUR BYES! Beats everybody! Off spinner pitching outside off, Kusal looks to play it against the spin towards third man but the ball spins a lot and beats everything including the keeper and goes away to the fence.
Once again it is in the pads, Angelo eases his flick towards mid-wicket and gets a single. This brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
On the pads, Mendis glances it to the on side for one more.
Floated on middle, Angelo strokes it to long on.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Graceful shot from Mendis. It was another full ball from Sarkar and Mendis duly obliges to hit the ball uppishly past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. Excellent shot from Kusal. 8 runs came off the over. 46 required from the last 15 overs. Sri Lanka cruising to a victory here.
Full delivery on off stump, Mathews pushes this down to long on and they cross over for a single.

Excellently bowled this! Sarkar rolls his hand on this like an off spinner. It is pitched outside off, Mathews looks to defend but misses. There is a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down. The impact seemed to be an issue and Hawk Eye confirms that.
Very full delivery from Sarkar, Mathews flicks it towards long on where  the fielder mops up. The batsman are able to take two.
Good length ball on the pads, Mendis pushes to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off stump, Mendis flicks it to the mid-wicket. No run.
Floated on the stumps, Angelo blocks it to see off the over.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mendis gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Flighted on off, KM strokes it straight to point.
On middle and leg, Angelo glances it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted on off, Kusal gets down on flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Kusal plays it straight to mid on.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Very well played from Mendis. It was a full delivery on the pads and Mendis faces no problem in flicking it away towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Runs coming thick and fast now for the Lankans.
Good length ball on middle pole which Mathews plays it towards mid on for another single.
Good length ball on the pads, Mendis flicks it nicely to deep square leg for a single.
On off, Mendis pushes it to covers.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Mathews runs it down to mid on and takes a quick single.
DRINKS! Soumya Sarkar is on now.
Loopy ball on off, Mathews strokes it to long on and gets to the other end.
Shorter and on off, this is pulled down to long on for one.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
A single now as this is eased down to long on.
FIVE WIDES! This is down the leg side and spins away further. Mathews looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to take it and it races away to the fine leg fence.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Floats it up on off, Mendis mistimes it towards square leg.
Mosaddek Hossain is back!
Another full delivery on middle, Mathews pushes it to mid on. No run. 8 runs came off the over.
This time fuller in length, Mathews defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short and waiting to be hit. It did not rise enough to trouble Mathews. Angelo just rocks back and pulls it towards square leg for a boundary. Poor bowling.
Slower one on middle, Mathews works it to mid on.
Short outside off stump, Mendis cuts towards deep cover for a single.
Nicely timed!   Shortish on the pads, Mathews flicks it nicely through the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for three.
Shortish ball on off, Mendis cuts it towards cover point and takes a single.
Good length ball on off, played back to the bowler.
This time on a good length on off, Mathews pushes this one towards covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Mendis slaps it through covers for one. Sabbir is bowling too short.
FOUR! Half-tracker bowled by Sabbir, and it gets the treatment. Short of a length on middle, Mendis bends and pulls it powerfully towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length outside off, Mathews plays this one towards deep cover point for a single.
Sabbir Rahman is on now!
Almost! This has pitched on middle and leg and nips back in. Mendis looks to flick but gets a feather on it onto his pads.
From around the wicket, this is angled outside off, Mendis cuts it to point.
On the shorter side, Mendis pulls it towards square leg, he fumbles but no runs conceded.
A slower one on middle, Mendis works it to mid-wicket.
A short one but it is way too short. Evaded and wided.
Another good length and on off, AM drives it through covers for one.
Back of a length on off, Mathews pushes it to mid off.
Shafiul Islam is back on!
Full ball, tossed up by Taijul. Mendis comes on the front foot and blocks it out. Good bowling by Taijul as he finishes with figures of 10-2-35-0.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another beauty! Beaten for the second time in a row. That too spun a long way. It lands on middle and then spins away. Mendis tries to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
BEATEN! Great bowling by Taijul. The ball pitches on off pole and the ball spins away sharply from Mendis. Mendis tries to block it out but it misses the outside edge of the bat.
Tossed up on off pole, Mendis guides this one to cover point.
Tossed up on off pole, Mendis gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it.
Length delivery around off, Mathews taps it to the man at short third man.
Slower yorker around off, Mathews strokes it to cover.
Good length ball around off, Mathews punches it to cover.
Outside off on a length, Kusal helps it to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, Kusal defends it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis taps it to point and shouts a loud no to his partner.

What a beauty by Taijul! This one is tossed up nicely and on the fourth stump line, it straightens sharply after pitching and beats the outside edge of Mathews' bat. He plays inside the line of the delivery but fortunately for him he doesn't get a nick on it.
Full length ball outside off, Mendis drives this one towards covers. The batters cross and take a single.
Full and tossed on the pads, Mendis blocks this one towards mid on.
Again similar line and length, this time Mendis pushes it towards cover point.
Full length ball on middle and off, it straightens after pitching.
Shorter and spinning away from Mendis. Kusal tucks it to square leg against the spin.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Full length ball on the off side, Mathews pushes it towards covers.
Good length ball on middle and off, the batter dabs it towards short extra cover.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Mustafizur gets his second of the game. Soft dismissal this for Perera. Fuller ball around off, Kusal Perera looks to drive it on the up. He does so but ends up hitting it uppishly and straight to covers. Soumya Sarkar there takes a good catch as the ball was struck with venom there. Sri Lanka need 93 in 152 balls now.
Good length ball outside off, Perera looks to cut but it comes off the inbner half of his bat.
OH! Length delivery outside off, Perera looks to pull but ends up getting an inside edge onto his front pad.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis taps it down to third man for a single.
The ball is full and tossed up on off, Mendis drives this one towards mid on for a single off the front foot.
On the pads of Mendis, he  flicks it towards fine leg. The ball rolls to fine leg but no runs taken.
Tossed up on off, Perera defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.
Flicked away towards square leg for a single.
Full ball on off, Perera pushes it towards the point fielder and quickly scampers through for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end, he hits the stumps but the runner is well in.

FOUR! Tossed up on a good length, Perera goes onto the back foot and tries to cut it. He does so but uppishly and luckily for him, it falls beyond the fielder at point and third man. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Mehedi Hasan is back on!
A slower short one outside off, Mendis looks to pull but is way too early in the shot. He misses.
On the stumps, Mendis defends it onto the ground.
On a length again around off, Mendis blocks it out.
Mendis works this one with the angle to square leg.
On the stumps, this is defended.
Fuller on off, it is driven through covers for one.
A single to end as Perera works it through square leg.
On middle, KP flicks it to mid-wicket.
On the pads again, Perera looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the pads, this is worked to short fine leg.
Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out. This is flatter and outside off, Perera looks to sweep but it hits his elbow and then onto the pads. The bowler appeals but it is not given.
Just wide! Perera is living dangerously out there. He comes down the track and then clips it wide of the diving mid-wicket fielder, down to long on for two.

FOUR! Edged but races away to the fence. Fullish ball outside the off stump, Kusal Mendis tries to go for the drive. He gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball goes towards the third man region for a boundary. Mendis gets off the mark with this shot.
Mustafizur is lucky to escape that. He bowls a full toss on off, Mendis hits it hard but straight to cover.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Fernando's fireworks comes to an end! Finally some respite for Mustafizur. He bowls another slower ball but this is on a length. It is around off, Fernando looks to flat bat it over mid off but he ends up slicing it to the right of the man there. Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal there moves to his right and takes a simple catch. End of a brilliant knock from the young Avishka. He won't get a ton here but he has taken his side very close to victory. 110 needed off 176 balls.
FOUR! What a shot! Slower ball pitching on the leg pole, Fernando picks it up early. He clears his front leg and smashes it over mid-wicket, one bounce into the fence for a boundary.
Full ball just outside the off pole, Fernando powerfully drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Length ball on middle and leg, Fernando plays it back to the bowler.

DROPPED! A tough chance but should have been taken. Hossain is the culprit. This needed to be taken. Fernando looks to go inside out over covers on this full ball outside off. He ends up slicing it towards sweeper covers. Mosaddek there runs to his right and then dives forward but fails to hang on. 8 from the over but there could have easily been two wickets in it.

Overthrow! Shorter and outside off, Perera looks to guide it down towards third man but it goes off the gloves. A single is not taken. The fielder though scores a needless direct hit at the striker's end. The ball deflects away from the fielder backing up and a single is taken.
Just short again! Perera comes down the track but gets to close to the ball. He works it uppishly but short of mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, Perera looks to defend but it goes off the outer half through point for one.

JUST OVER AND FOUR! This boundary brings up the 50-run partnership between the two. It was a loopy delivery and on middle. Perera comes forward and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket where the ball flies just above the fielder's head and the ball goes for a four. It has been a good partnership for the Lankans and they would want to see it continue for them throughout the innings.
An appeal but it is an ambitious one! This is shorter around leg pole. Fernando looks to flick it over the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
One more single as Perera pushes it to mid off.
How easy was that? A cutter outside off, Fernando waits for it and gently guides it down to third man for one.

In the air... but falls safe! Everything going Sri Lanka's way. A poor shot though. This is short and angling away from the batter. Fernando looks to heave it across the line but only gets a top edge which clears mid on. Two taken.
A yorker on off, Fernando jams it out to mid off.
Lovely flick shot! Full and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket and the batters take two.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on!
Flatter on off, Fernando milks it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, AF pushes it to cover.
Floated on the stumps, Avishka defends it off the front foot.
Leg Bye! Short Delivery on leg, Perera  tries to flick it but gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball goes towards the leg side for a single.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Avishka comes down the track and hits it past the cover fielder where the long off fieldewr comes around and cleans it up. Single taken.
On the pads and short, Kusal looks to flick but it deflects off his thigh pad. They steal a leg bye.
WIDE! Once again Taijul misses his line and sprays it down the leg side. It has been wided by the umpire.
WIDE! Strays down the leg side. Perera tries to flick but cannot put bat on it and it is given a wide.
Change of ends for Taijul Islam.

Drinks Break! Sri Lanka are cruising along here. They are looking strong at the moment and they need 134 runs off 198 balls with 9 wickets in hand. Bangladesh need to pick wickets here. There is good amount of spin and grip available on the deck but they need to correct their lines. Only wickets can pull this game in their favour here.
On middle and leg, AF flicks it but straight to mid-wicket. 10 runs came off the over.
FOUR! Poor stuff from Mosaddek. It was a loopy delivery on leg stump and Avishka moves towards the off side and sweeps it past the fine leg fielder for the second boundary of the over.
Shorter in length and outside off stump, Perera cuts towards cover and gives Avishka the strike.

FOUR! Brilliantly executed reverse sweep by Perera. Full on leg and middle, Kusal gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it fine towards third man region for a boundary. 100 comes up for Sri Lanka with that.
Shorter this time, Avishka moves it away from his pads towards square leg and takes a single.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, Avishka flicks it away towards fine leg but no run taken.
Mosaddek Hossain is on!
Floated on middle and leg, Avishka glances it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
On the pads, KP flicks it to the on side and gets one.
On off, Perera defends it off the front foot.

OH! Inside edge saves him there. Tossed up around off, Avishka tries to be aggressive and comes down the track. He gets an inside edge on it which goes towards fine leg. Had he missed that, he was gone for all money.
Shorter on off, Perera punches it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Floated on off, Kusal defends it off the front foot.
Floated on leg, Avishka looks to defend but it hits him on his pad. There is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire. It seemed to be missing leg.
Tossed up on middle, Kusal strokes it to long on and gets to the other end.
Another loopy delivery on middle, Avishka dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground towards mid on for a single.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Avishka comes forward and defends back to the bowler.
Shorter this time on off stump, Avishka cuts but straight to point for a dot ball.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Avishka drives it to point. No run.
Now calmly flicks this to mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single.
SIX! That was six the moment it left the bat. Floated on off and middle, Avishka gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Tossed up on off, Perera sweeps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on the stumps, Kusal defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Perera looks to play the reverse sweep but luckily manages to get an inside edge onto his pads.

Poor from the man at short fine leg but Shaiful does well to stop it from going to the fence. Floated on the pads, Fernando flicks it past the man at short fine leg. Shaiful Islam gives it a chase and pulls it back before the ropes saving a run for his side.
Tossed up on off, Kusal squeezes it through covers and gets a couple.
Floated on middle, Avishka milks it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and full on middle, Avishka strokes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and full on off, Avishka taps it back to the bowler.
Shorter around off, Perera cuts it towards point and takes a single.

SECOND ODI FIFTY FOR AVISHKA FERNANDO! This youngster is some player. The shots he has played in this innings has been just brilliant. He would be eyeing something big here. It is a short delivery on middle, Avishka plays it to mid on for a single.
Turn and bounce on this one. Flighted around off, Kusal plays it with the spin towards point. Good over for Bangladesh. 4 runs off it but more importantly a wicket off it.
Floated on middle, Avishka strokes it to long on for one.
Perera is off the mark straight away. Flatter on off, Kusal punches it to the left of mid off and takes a single.
Kusal Perera is the new man in. He scored a ton in the last game and anything similar would see Sri Lanka win.

OUT! Bowled! Bangladesh have their much-needed breakthrough here. The ploy to replace Mustafizur with Mehedi has worked. Mehedi comes around the wicket and bowls a quicker one on middle and leg, Karunaratne hangs back and looks to play it off the back foot. The ball though skids onto him and deflects off his pads onto the stumps. This might just be the opening Bangladesh wanted. 168 needed in 231 balls now.
Short around off, Avishka punches it towards cover and takes a single. Moves to 48 with that.
Darts one on the pads, Karunaratne looks to flick but the ball kisses his pads. The ball deflects off the keeper's pad and they take a leg bye.
Mehedi Hasan is back into the attack.
Loopy delivery on middle, Avishka comes forward and blocks it towards the point fielder. First maiden of the match.
Beautiful ball this! Tossed up around off, it spins away from Avishka. Fernando looks to defend it with soft hands but gets a thick outside edge which goes along the ground to point.
Beaten! Excellent delivery, flatter ball spinning away from the batsman. Avishka tries to defend but misses. Taijul is getting good spin here.
Slower through the air on off, Fernando plays it late but finds short third man. Avishka wanted a single but that was never existent there.
Another loopy delivery, Fernando plays it back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery on middle, Avishka drives to cover for a dot ball.
Powerplay 2 time now! 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle now till the 40th over. The way Sri Lanka are batting, Bangladesh needed to spread out the field.

Length ball on off side, Fernando just guides this one towards the third man region and keeps the strike. Sri Lanka end the first powerplay in dominating fashion as they have scored 69 with both of their openers still at the crease and going strong. Bangladesh need to take some quick wickets here.
Length ball on middle and off, Fernando plays it towards point.
WIDE! Bouncer but way too high. This is bowled on middle and leg, hitting it hard on the deck. Maybe just too hard as the ball goes way over the head of Fernando to the keeper.
Wide and full outside off, Fernando lashes at it. He gets the outer half of his bat and the ball goes to deep backward point where the fielder cuts it off and the batters take a couple.
Nothing off the Free Hit! Full outside off, Fernando hits it hard but straight to point.
WIDE! Free Hit continues. Mustafizur looks to bowl it outside off and make the batsman stretch out for it but he bowls this on the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided.
NO BALL! Mustafizur is struggling here. He oversteps his line. Full ball on off, Avishka defends it off the front foot. Free Hit to follow.
SIX! Poor from Mustafizur and Avishka has demolished that. Bouncer from Mustafizur. It is on middle, Avishka picks the length early and whacks his pull over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Nice ball. Good length ball outside off, it moves away after pitching. Avishka swings his bat at it but misses.
Once again it is on the pads, Avishka looks to paddle it but the ball goes wide of the keeper off his pads and they take a leg bye.
On the pads, AF flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Beautiful from the batsmen this time. Tossed up on off, Fernando comes down the track and lofts it inside out over extra cover for a boundary.

Beauty! Absolute beauty from Islam! Flighted around leg. It spins in to the right-hander. Fernando looks to defend but misses and the ball hits him on the thigh pad of his back leg. There is a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down. They think about the review but opt against it. Height seemed to be an issue and Hawk Eye later on confirms that.
Floated on the pads, this time Dimuth is able to flick it towards square leg for a single.
Darts one on the pads, Karunaratne looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full ball on the off side, Fernando pushes this towards the cover fielder. An eventful over comes to an end.
Fuller again, Fernando gets the bottom of his bat on it and the ball rolls towards the keeper.

FOUR! Another boundary! French cut this time! Bonus runs here for Sri Lanka. This time Mustafizur bowls it full and on off, Fernando tries to push at it but gets an inside edge on it. The ball rolls towards the fine leg region and across the fence.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Bad bowling by the Fizz! Short and just outside off, Fernando steps onto the back foot and jabs it over the mid on fielder. It goes towards the long on fence for a boundary.
Short of a length on the off side, Fernando cuts it towards the cover point fielder. He fumbles it but no harm done.
On the pads of Avishka, he flicks it towards the gap at mid-wicket with soft hands and sets off for a couple. The fielders give it a chase and the batters easily get a couple.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side. Fernando swings but misses, wide signalled by the umpire.
Another change in bowling. Tamim has given the ball to his strike bowler, Mustafizur Rahman.
A single to end another good over for Sri Lanka. Flatter on off, this is pushed down to long off for one. Runs needed below 200 now.
Floats it up this time, it is kept out.

FOUR! Too short again and this time Islam does not get away with it. Sri Lanka dealing in boundaries. This is short and around off, it sits up to be hit. Fernando goes back and pushes it through covers. The ball races away to the fence.
Fires it on off, Karnaratne works it through mid-wicket for one.
This is worked through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers. He starts off with a loosener but did not cost him anything.
Taijul Islam is on now!

Dimuth caps off a superb over for Sri Lanka with a couple. Again on the pads, Dimuth just flicks it with the angle towards fine leg. The batters take a couple. 16 off the over and Sri Lanka are off to a very good start in this run chase.
A leg bye now! On the pads of Fernando, he tries to clip it but misses. It hits the pads and rolls towards fine leg as the batters cross for a single.

FOUR! Three boundaries in a row! Fernando is taking Islam to the cleaners! This time Shafiul bowls it shorter around off, Fernando goes onto the back foot and pulls it over the square leg fielder inside the circle. It races towards the fence and four runs are awarded to Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Wider this time but the result is the same. Good length ball outside off, Fernando just leans into it and drives this one towards cover point for a boundary.
FOUR! Length ball on the off side, Avishka plays this ball on the up, gets on the front foot and punches it strongly through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, Fernando goes after it but misses.
Length delivery and on middle, Fernando strokes it back to the bowler.
Well bowled! Tosses it up around off, it pitches and turns away. Karunaratne looks to drive but it goes off the outer half towards point.
Goes back to bowling it on the stumps, Dimuth defends it.
FOUR! First real loose ball by Hasan and he pays the price. Short and wide outside off, Karunaratne goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary. First of the chase.
Another single! Shorter and on middle, Fernando looks to push it down to long on but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for one.
Good running! Floats it up on off, DK pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
Angles it into the pads, it skids through. Karunaratne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Short of a length ball on off, Dimuth goes onto the back foot and punches the ball towards mid on. The batters take a single.
Way outside off, Dimuth lets it go through to the keeper.
Another inswinger but the line is a little too straight this time. Karunaratne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

An appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Now, Shafiul looks interested in this one. Loud appeal by the Bangladeshi team but the umpire says no as he feels it is too high for his liking. The ball is pitched just outside off and nips back in after pitching, Dimuth plays at it but just outside the line of the ball. Shafiul is interested in taking the review but the skipper, Tamim Iqbal refuses straight away. The replays also show that there was an inside edge on the ball. Overall a good decision by the umpire as well as skipper Tamim Iqbal.
Well bowled! Length ball pitched just outside off, it straightens after pitching. Dimuth plays it back towards mid on.
Full on and just outside off pole, Avishka jams it out and the ball rolls towards third man for a single.

The ball just did not come onto the bat there! This is flatter and around off, it is shorter in length. Karnaratne looks to go over covers but is early in the shot. It goes off the inner half to mid-wicket. Just the single from the over then.
This is fired on the off pole, Karunaratne is solid in defense.
OHHHH! Slightly shorter and outside off, this one stays low. DK looks to cut but misses.
Floats it up on off, Karunaratne strokes it to mid off.
Hasan tosses this one up, Fernando comes down the track and hits it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, Fernando defends it out.
Length ball on middle and off, Dimuth punches it towards mid on off the inner portion of his bat.
Short of a length ball on off, Dimuth tries to run it down to third man. The ball hits high on the bat and it rolls towards the slip cordon.
Length ball on the fourth stump line, it hits the inner half of the bat and rolls towards mid on.
This time on the pads of Dimuth, he glances it down to the deep backward square leg fielder. The batters cross and take two runs.
A bit shorter in length this time, again left alone by Karunaratne.
Good length ball just outside off by Islam, Dimuth lets it go through to the keeper.
Shafiul Islam to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Single to end the over. 6 runs off the first over. The last ball is flighted on off, Karunaratne strokes it to cover and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on off, Karunaratne nudges it to mid off.
Short on off, Karunaratne punches it through covers and gets a couple to get off the mark.
The chase is underway! On the pads, Avishka glances it fine down the leg side. The boundaries are big here on square of the wicket and the batsmen come back for the third.
Floated on the stumps, Fernando blocks it off the front foot.
Starts with a tossed up ball on the stumps, Fernando does not go for the biggie straightaway and calmly blocks it.
We are back for the chase! Avishka Fernando and skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne walk out the middle. Mehedi Hasan to start the proceedings with the first new ball. The former to take the strike.
